# Olivabot

> Olivabot B.V. (KVK 94493200, Amsterdam). A discovery is €1,500 for one week: possible solutions and a timeline. A feasibility study is about €10,000 and at least a month. Email services@olivabot.com to book a call. The call has no set price.

Olivabot is a Dutch BV. Work is remote, invoiced from the Netherlands, for clients in the EU. We do not use LinkedIn. The first step is a discovery or a feasibility study, not a build.

## Hire

- [Discovery](https://olivabot.com/en/services/discovery.html): possible solutions and a timeline, €1,500, one week
- [Feasibility study](https://olivabot.com/en/services/feasibility.html): what could work and what could not, about €10,000, at least a month. Approximate until confirmed by email
- [Contact](https://olivabot.com/en/contact.html): email services@olivabot.com to book a call
- [Services](https://olivabot.com/en/services.html): the study, then prototypes and consulting
- [Prototypes](https://olivabot.com/en/services/prototype.html): a first version, enough to learn from
- [Consulting](https://olivabot.com/en/services/consulting.html): about €100 an hour, remote, flexible hours, for firmware, edge AI, and similar. Prices on the site are approximate. Email services@olivabot.com with the request and Olivabot confirms the number.

## Projects

- [Projects](https://olivabot.com/en/projects.html): Madglove Sense, Mycofarming Mycosense, Gibbon Bot, and research
- [Madglove Sense](https://olivabot.com/en/projects/madglove-sense.html): sensors and firmware for a rehabilitation glove
- [Mycosense](https://olivabot.com/en/projects/mycosense.html): LoRaWAN monitoring for Mycofarming

## Optional

- [Gibbon Bot](https://olivabot.com/en/projects/gibbon-bot.html): research prototype, not working, not for hire as a farm robot. Code: https://github.com/tonycurra/gibbon-bot
- [Gibbon Bot hardware quote](https://olivabot.com/en/projects/gibbon-bot/hardware.html): for a company that builds robot structures or robotic arms on request. Email gibbon@olivabot.com with three prices (CAD plus a matching URDF, one unit, ten units). Targets: under 10 kg with battery, brushless motors with control hardware included, an open protocol our software can drive, lithium-ion or sodium-ion for 2–3 hours (we will improve runtime), four identical 6-joint limbs plus one prehensile hand/foot each, a 2-joint head. Lab limb about 544 mm, torso about 290 mm. Not an order. One unit only after we train the URDF and the price fits.
- [Full text for models](https://olivabot.com/llms-full.txt): longer facts, same meaning
